name: Mysticism
desc: Benson's lecture on mysticism (1907), delivered at Westminster, with a preface: what the mystical experience is, how the Catholic Church understands it and its place in the Christian life.
desc_pt: A conferência de Benson sobre o misticismo (1907), proferida em Westminster, com um prefácio: o que é a experiência mística, como a Igreja Católica a entende e seu lugar na vida cristã.
editor: Robert Hugh Benson (London: Catholic Truth Society, 1907)
edition: Mysticism (London: Catholic Truth Society, 1907), Internet Archive full-text OCR (Mysticism1907).
